title: Axecleft's Printable Sheets
description: Print 3.5 SRD (D35E) actors on paper: characters as a classic 3.5 or eTools-style character sheet or a Monster Manual-style stat block; merchants as a price list (the GM's copy with the full stock and shop settings); loot piles, party storage and Hoard Editor hoards as a contents list (the GM's with values, lock and trap); traps as DMG-style trap blocks; familiars, animal companions and special mounts as a stat block with their master and advancement. Adds a Print button to actor sheets and print entries to the Actors sidebar menu.
